subject: Staggered credit pools for parallel benchmark RFP
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
To: James Park <james.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staggered credit pools for parallel benchmark RFP

Hi James —

Thanks again for the time this morning. To help Acme run parallel benchmarks across three teams (search relevance, summarization, and private-deployment latency), we can structure credits as staggered pools so you can spin up tests in parallel without losing control of spend. Proposed structure below: 

- Baseline evaluation pool: 250,000 tokens (for parity tests and regression checks)
- Feature-focused pool: 150,000 tokens (for deep feature tests: tool-calling, structured outputs)
- High-throughput stress pool: 50,000 tokens (for scaled latency/throughput runs)
- Contingent top-up: up to 100,000 tokens if benchmarks show >10% perf delta vs incumbent (requires short write-up)

All pools would be valid for 45 days from embargoed start date. Credits are usable against Redwood hosted API and can be applied to a Dedicated trial if you move forward with a POC—we'll switch the allocation upon agreement.

Attachments: staggered-credit-pools-v1.xlsx (counts and suggested distribution).

If this looks reasonable I can loop in Finance for a quick approval and get terms penned. Would you prefer a single pooled expiry or staggered expirations per team?

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-1299

From: James Park <james.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered credit pools for parallel benchmark RFP

Lauren —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple quick clarifications before we send this to the two engineering leads: 

1) Expiration: will the contingent top-up follow the 45-day window or be allowed an extended approval window? Our accuracy team often needs extra time to validate model regressions.
2) Scope: can those credits be applied to both the hosted sandbox and a short-term Dedicated node if we need to mirror production?
3) Competitive context: the incumbent is offering an open 90-day trial for benchmarking; we need a downside protection clause if they beat us on TCO.

If you can escalate a slightly longer window for the contingent tranche (60 days) and confirm dedicated usage, we can circulate to procurement today.

Thanks,
James
James Park
VP, Platform Engineering | Acme Health
james.park@acmehealth.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, James Park <james.park@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Staggered credit pools for parallel benchmark RFP — request for approval

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding the note from Acme. They asked specifically for: 
- contingent top-up expiry extended to 60 days
- confirmation that credits can be used against a short-term Dedicated node if needed
- some protection language if a competitor offers a longer trial window (we typically do not match open 90-day unrestricted trials)

My ask: can Finance approve a 450k aggregate allocation instead of the 550k proposed (baseline+feature+stress+contingent) and allow the contingent tranche to be claimable within 60 days? We can require MSA signature + completed security questionnaire before Dedicated allocations are enabled. If we cap at 450k, we keep exposure limited but stay competitive.

I've attached the counts and a suggested redemption flow in the spreadsheet. Quick ping — can you greenlight this with any required guardrails?

—Lauren

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, James Park <james.park@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Staggered credit pools for parallel benchmark RFP — approval memo

Lauren —

Thanks for the detail and for flagging the competitive pressure. Finance is comfortable with a capped offer if we attach the following guardrails: 

- Approved allocation: 450,000 tokens total, split as 225k baseline / 125k feature / 50k stress / 50k contingent
- Contingent tranche claim window: 60 days from start date (approved)
- Credits are applicable to Redwood hosted API immediately; Dedicated trial access requires signed MSA and completed security questionnaire (we will enable migration of unused hosted credits to Dedicated on a 1:1 basis once the MSA is countersigned)
- Expiration: 60 days for all tranches (stagger allowed by request but final expiry 60 days)
- Require a short results write-up for contingent claims (one page) and a single executive sponsor from Acme to approve release

I've attached an approval memo. Marissa — please capture this as a promo in the deal record and add the DocuSign MSA link to the related links. Lauren — you can share the approved memo with James and procurement, and I recommend we ask for a procurement signature within 7 days of acceptance.

Approved by: Ben Carter, Finance (on behalf of Redwood Inference)

Attachment: approved-credit-memo.pdf

Best,
Ben
